hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFeeV2
hook.description: Clanker v2 hook that applies asymmetric static LP fees per pool (separate rates for buying vs selling the Clanker token), collects a 20% protocol fee on all swaps by manipulating beforeSwap/afterSwap deltas, and optionally runs a MEV protection module active for 2 minutes post-launch plus pool extension callbacks.
